title: drymocallis glandulosa subsp. ewanii
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa subsp. ewanii, commonly known as Western Sweetroot, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States and Canada. As a medicinal plant, Western Sweetroot has been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which provide numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Western Sweetroot include glycosides, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Therapeutically, Western Sweetroot is used to treat digestive issues, infections, and skin conditions, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
